subject to operating and economic conditions
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively quantitative and provides useful operating and liquidity context, but relies on forward-looking language around recovery, consumer behavior, film availability, interest expense, and capital spending. Pandemic-related revenue shortfalls, impairment charges, dependence on industry recovery, and uncertainty around borrowing and marketable securities remain material risks despite management’s positive liquidity and balance-sheet tone.
